li_projects.title: GradeSpec
li_projects.description: A grade dashboard and calculator for university students. Track your academic performance across terms, calculate your GPA, and project future grade scenarios.

li_projects.title: Reddit Thread Navigator
li_projects.description: Designed a Reddit feature that helps users navigate long threads by surfacing key discussion branches before they commit to reading. Capstone project for the Ivey Product Society Fellowship.

li_projects.title: Fifty Years of Music
li_projects.description: Data project exploring how popular music has changed over the last 50 years by analyzing Billboard chart data alongside Spotify audio features. I examined long-term shifts in qualities like danceability, energy, and mood.

posts.text: Excited to share that I'll be joining the OpenAI Student Collective as a Campus Lead at Western University! When I first used ChatGPT in my IB physics class, it was only a chatbot. Since then, its capabilities have grown immensely, and I can't wait to help you make the most of what it can do :) I'll be hosting workshops, studio hours, and opportunities alongside Yogya Kalra to explore and build with ChatGPT & OpenAI tools on campus. If you're part of a student organization at Western, feel free

Finals season again. Time to confront your grades, whether you're ready or not. Jokes aside, I built GradeSpec last semester out of pure frustration with outdated grade calculators. Apart from pestering my friends to sign up, I didn't expect much from it—but watching it get used by students across the country has been one of the coolest parts of my year. So I kept building. Here's what's new: 🎓 6 Universities Supported: Western, UofT, Waterloo, UBC, McMaster, and Queen's, each with their own GPA

Last finals season, I got sick of using the same outdated grade calculator websites. It was annoying to re-enter my marks and hunt for assessment weights every time I wanted to check what I needed on a final to keep my average. I just wanted a single place that remembered my grades and handled the math for me.
